melt_spin_budget.note: Zero by design, for three reasons that all point the same way. (1) The ruling: no SFX, and Mike did not take the offered soft sounds at the chart reveals; every MELT and SPIN row carries a baked whoosh. (2) Register: a calm gear 2 explainer on one drone bed; melt reads as a spectral burst and every spin row is high energy. (3) Structure: the three cover-to-cover candidates (33.78 C3, 194.41 the C1 funnel map, 385.88 C4) all enter on an empty or ghost frame that draws itself on the words, with the bed marking each one by its own step or fuller run, so a marquee move would reform into a nearly blank frame; the fourth (353.48 C1 ALL) is a face edge, where the film burn opens onto the finished map.

consistency_check: No title card (one drone bed, every chapter card OFF), so the card move never fires: rmn:flip is standby only, 0 card rows. ONE face pick, hand:film-burn, on all 17 face edges (8 cut-ins, 9 cut-outs; F1 opens the video, so it has no cut-in). ONE cover-to-cover move, hand:xfade-scale (0.35 s, 0.93 to 1; the two animated charts enter on their header at 0.97 to 1 per their specs), on all 27 container / diagram / chart / receipt swaps: text containers stay quiet, and so do the charts. ZERO melt, ZERO spin, zero glitch (no AI stills, no Envato video and no clip inserts in this video, so those buckets are empty). ONE punch leak, on the ONE real interior face join (F3, 124.289), from a one-look Soft set; no punch and no leak on F1, F2 and F4 to F9, which have no interior join. 3 receipt pans confirmed from the EDIT-PLAN (three different MOTION moves, single-scene camera moves, not cuts). SILENT: every hand move is silent, the MOTION rows carry no sound, and the leak row carries sfx_rel_db -60 so its baked whoosh is inaudible. Occlusion: every swap fades the incoming cover in OVER the outgoing one held at full opacity, and every cover tIn sits on its face-out, so the blacked spine (and the blacked-out FACE 4 line under D18) never shows. State swaps inside a cover (the C1 and C2 states, the C2 THEN to NOW camera pan at 153.40, card -sN states, receipt view changes) are spotlight moves or quick cross-fades from the asset specs, not transition rows. Rows: 44 scene changes + 1 punch leak + 3 receipt pans = 48.
open_questions: Punch points: the joins file (spine/jumpcuts-final.json) lists 4 punch candidates (F3 124.067, F7 352.933, F8 441.633, F9 464.4); this plan carries ONE, at 124.289. I re-measured the picture: a per-frame scene score on a face crop of all 9 windows shows one jump cut in the whole video, F3 at 124.289 (0.188 on a 0.002 floor); nothing in F7, F8 or F9 rises above head and hand motion (0.04). Their listed points are the face-out edge joins: in every window the last listed join trails the real edge by a lag that grows from 0.02 s at F1 to 0.75 s at F9, the map drift PROJECT-LOG already records. A punch there would zoom inside owns, left and owns. For the build: take the punch frame from this plan and the EDIT-PLAN (124.289, frame 3729), never from punch_candidates_s.

More movement on the long holds is your call: F4 (6.2 s), F8 (4.9 s) and F9 (5.0 s) have no interior join, so the rule gives them no punch and no leak. If you want one on any of them it is your exception to the join rule; the fresh Soft leaks soft-3, soft-4 and soft-7 are reserved for it.

Leak sound: the one library light leak carries a baked whoosh and mix_music.py lays it with no mute switch. To keep your no-SFX ruling the row carries sfx_rel_db -60, which leaves it inaudible. If you would like that one soft whoosh under the second half of the thesis line, delete the field on that row. For the build: the mix sidecar should show 1 lib_sfx at around -60 dB or lower.

F3 is busy for 1.93 s: burn in, the leak blink with the punch on the join, burn out, with around 0.39 s of clean face between each. I kept it because the step lands exactly on the pivot of the thesis line. If it strobes in the draft, the first fix is to drop the leak and keep the punch step alone; the second is to shorten the two F3 burns to 0.25 s a side.

Zero melt and zero spin, on purpose (no SFX, calm register, and the charts and the map enter empty and build on your words). If you want ONE marquee move anyway, it is the funnel map at 194.41: swap that row to lib:melt-rgb-soft-1 (0.84 s, role MELT-transform, the four numbered slots reflow into the map), sound trimmed silent the same way. I advise against it: the map enters as a ghost outline, so the melt would resolve into a nearly empty frame.

Face pick is film burn again (it also ran on canton and AI destroying lives; advisory slot). It is the only silent, calm sanctioned face move, so I kept it; Blocks Max would put 17 glitch shatters with sound on a drone explainer.

For the reconcile step, not a creative call: the plan has 48 rows (44 scene changes + 1 punch leak + 3 receipt pans the EDIT-PLAN already names). The RESOLVED line of the CUE-SHEET still quotes the earlier plan (54 scene changes, 7 leaks on joins that do not exist) and needs its counts refreshed.
